mentions.name: Human Wake-Up Call App
mentions.description: A mobile app that lets users schedule wake-up calls answered by real people from anywhere in the world. Calls are placed over VoIP inside the app, so no phone numbers are exchanged.
mentions.source_excerpt: It's an app that allows you to schedule a wake-up call and get a real call from a friendly person, somewhere in the world. No phone numbers exchanged. All calls happen through VoIP in the app.

evidence.value: It's an app that allows you to schedule a wake-up call and get a real call from a friendly person, somewhere in the world. No phone numbers exchanged. All calls happen through VoIP in the app.
